The information below is lifted straight from official UVM documents and campus resources. You've likely already seen most of it in your other course syllabi, since it's the same for every UVM class. It's still worth a skim at the start of the semester. Anything in the main [Syllabus](syllabus.qmd) is an additional layer on top of these bedrock university guidelines.

---

## Lived Name and Pronoun Information

The UVM Directory includes fields for indicating your lived name and your pronouns. Lived names (preferred names, names in use) are names that an individual wants to be known by in the University community. Entering your pronouns is strongly encouraged to help create a more inclusive and respectful campus community. To update your information, log in to the UVM Directory. A preview box will let you see how this information will appear in other campus systems.

For help selecting research topics, finding information, citing sources, and more, ask a librarian. The UVM Libraries are eager to help, by phone, email, chat, text, or individual consultation.

- Howe Library: [library.uvm.edu/askhowe](https://library.uvm.edu/askhowe)

## Course Evaluation

All students are expected to complete an evaluation of the course at its conclusion. Evaluations are anonymous and confidential; the feedback gained, including constructive criticism, is used to improve the course.

---

## Potential Changes During the Semester

The University of Vermont reserves the right to make changes in course offerings, mode of delivery, degree requirements, charges, regulations, and procedures as educational, financial, health, safety, and welfare considerations require, or as necessary to comply with governmental, accreditation, or public health directives. See the [UVM Catalogue](http://catalogue.uvm.edu/) for the general statement.

---

## Intellectual Property / Prohibition on Sharing Academic Materials

Students are prohibited from publicly sharing or selling academic materials they did not author — for example, the class syllabus, outlines or presentations authored by the professor, practice questions, textbook excerpts, or other copyrighted class materials — and from sharing assessments such as homework or take-home exams. Violations are handled under UVM's Intellectual Property policy and Code of Academic Integrity.

## Student Learning Accommodations

In keeping with University policy, any student with a documented disability interested in utilizing ADA accommodations should contact **Student Accessibility Services (SAS)**, UVM's office of Disability Services for students. SAS works with students and faculty in an interactive process to explore reasonable and appropriate accommodations, which are communicated to faculty in an accommodation letter. All students are strongly encouraged to discuss with their instructor the accommodations they plan to use in each course.

**Contact SAS:**
A170 Living/Learning Center · (802) 656-7753 · [access@uvm.edu](mailto:access@uvm.edu) · [www.uvm.edu/access](https://www.uvm.edu/access)

## Important UVM Policies

**Academic Integrity** — Addresses plagiarism, fabrication, collusion, and cheating.

**Code of Student Conduct** — Outlines conduct expectations as well as students' rights and responsibilities.

**FERPA Rights Disclosure** — Communicates students' rights regarding access to, and privacy of, their educational records under the Family Educational Rights and Privacy Act (FERPA) of 1974.

**Final Exam Policy** — Outlines expectations during final exams and explains the timing and process of the examination period.

**Grade Appeals** — The procedure to follow if you would like to contest a grade.

**Grading** — GPA calculation and general grading information.

**Religious Holidays** — Students have the right to practice the religion of their choice. Each semester, students should submit in writing to their instructor(s) — as early as possible, and at least one week before a documented religious holiday — the date(s) of any conflict or absence. Faculty must permit students who miss work or exams for religious observance to make up that work.

*(Full text of these policies is maintained centrally by UVM. Search [uvm.edu/policies](https://www.uvm.edu/policies) for the current version of any policy named above.)*
